set.body: From the P0-2 final re-verification (privacy-proof-review): contract.scala:127/210 DigestAuthority.Keyed(snapshot) keeps SensitiveKeySnapshot.owned inside a long-lived audit value (heap-dump/serialization leak surface; equals/toString exclude it). Fix: receipt stores (kind, keyId) only; the conforming wrapper / addResultDecisions re-supplies the snapshot via an explicit keyed path; law: no receipt value transitively holds key bytes (reflection-free check: type-level — the receipt type has no field of the snapshot type). Also remove unused renderingV1 (contract.scala:326-344) or exercise it in a format-detection test. Must land before any receipt codec. Gate: embed-core JVM/JS/Native, compileAll.
set.title: embed-core: AttemptReceipt must not own secret key bytes for its lifetime (DigestAuthority.Keyed(snapshot)) — store (kind, keyId) and route amendments through an explicit keyed path; remove dead renderingV1
